examples.title: Bulk buying needs a use-by plan

The five-rand price gap trap A five-rand lower shelf price can disappear at checkout. Illustrative example: R95 plus R40 delivery totals R135. R100 with free collection totals R100, before travel costs. Compare the full cost of getting it home. Start your next price check: https://www.cwhereucheaper.co.za/?utm_source=tiktok&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=30_day_shopping_tips&utm_content=20261108-pm AI narration and original motion graphics. #SouthAfrica #ShoppingTips #CwhereUcheaper

Separate a want from a shopping need A shopping list can lose its shape when every aisle has an offer. Before adding an unplanned item, name the job it will do and when you will use it. If that answer is unclear, pause before checkout.
